10547.t: PERSPECTOR OF ABC AND CROSS-TRIANGLE OF ABC AND 1st ORTHOSYMMEDIAL TRIANGLE

golden.sn: Lies on the vertical axis of symmetry

gnomon.sn: Lies on the vertical axis of symmetry

10547.en: Let A'B'C' be the reflection of ABC in X_6. Let A_{B} = BC∩C'A', A_{C} = BC∩A'B', and define B_{C}, B_{A}, C_{A}, C_{B} cyclically. A_{B}, A_{C}, B_{C}, B_{A}, C_{A}, C_{B} lie on the 2nd Lemoine circle. Triangles :g:`AA_{B}A_{C} << A A_B A_C >>`, :g:`B_{A}BB_{C} << B_A B B_C >>`, :g:`C_{A}C_{B}C << C_A C_B C >>` are similar to one another and inversely similar to ABC. Let \(S_{A}\) be the similitude center of :g:`B_{A}BB_{C} << B_A B B_C >>` and :g:`C_{A}C_{B}C << C_A C_B C >>`. Let \(S_{B}\) be the similitude center of :g:`C_{A}C_{B}C << C_A C_B C >>` and :g:`AA_{B}A_{C} << A A_B A_C >>`. Let \(S_{C}\) be the similitude center of :g:`AA_{B}A_{C} << A A_B A_C >>` and :g:`B_{A}BB_{C} << B_A B B_C >>`. \(S_{A}\) \(S_{B}\) \(S_{C}\) is perspective to ABC at X_6 and homothetic to the circumsymmedial triangle at X_6. X_10547 is the trilinear product \(S_{A}\) * \(S_{B}\) * \(S_{C}\).
